title: Is the universe infinite? The answer quickly gets weird
seoTitle: Is the universe infinite? The answer quickly gets weird
subtitle: Measurements of ancient light reveal that the cosmos is remarkably flat, but the definitive answer remains complex.
excerpt: Ancient cosmic microwave background light measurements suggest the universe is flat, but this doesn’t prove it’s infinite.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The mystery of the cosmos' vastness

Recent measurements of ancient light from the cosmic microwave background indicate that the universe is remarkably flat. However, this observation does not serve as definitive proof that the cosmos is infinite.

The complexity arises from the fact that the observable cosmos may represent only a small fraction of a much larger universe that possesses curvature.

Spatial geometry and possibilities

The possibilities for the structure of space go beyond the obvious. Space can be perfectly flat while simultaneously folding onto itself in ways considered exotic.

Thus, the geometry of the universe continues to intrigue researchers, showing that the answer to whether it is infinite or bounded can become strange very quickly when analyzing the vastness of space.

With information from ScienceDaily.
